analysis_name: BTC Polymarket T-59 frozen-model execution reassessment
calendar: one expected market-start row every 5 minutes from the first Gamma-confirmed series market through cutoff; missing Gamma records are retained

binance_public_extension.source_semantics: COIN-M BTCUSD index OHLC plus UM BTCUSDT trade volume and auxiliary OHLC, matching the frozen hybrid input columns

kacho.semantics: market-start and 1Hz post-start observations; no T-59 prestart ask, so not used to fill PMXT T-59 gaps

pmxt_extraction.row_group_filter: market condition_id min/max statistics then exact id and timestamp_received cutoff through market start plus max order delay

t59_replay.semantics: single T-59 replay, native token asks retained separately from bids; events grouped by receive timestamp and source-ordered within equal receive times; no later receive events accepted

execution.cost_basis_equity_definition: cash plus gross cost basis of unsettled positions
execution.entry_rule: market start minus 59 seconds (decision at minus 60 seconds plus 1-second order delay)
execution.ev_rule: choose the priceable side with greater positive net expected payout; skip when neither has positive EV; no other edge filter
execution.fee_assumption: T-59 PMXT fee rate when observed; historical collection mode/exponent/rounding from existing replay assumptions; cash fees debit cash, outcome-share fees reduce shares
execution.hold: to official resolution; release cash at max(Gamma closedTime, market start + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds
execution.insufficient_depth: skip the entire requested stake; no implicit downsize
execution.minimum_order_size: Gamma current orderMinSize when present; otherwise 5 shares as a stated current-metadata fallback, not historical metadata

legacy_4830_diagnosis.classification_note: Recovery partitions require a new $5 native ask fill. Implementation signal means an old ask-BBO mismatch disappeared under side-specific causal replay; qualification recovery means the old rejection is not supported by the ask path (typically crossed/missing bid) and the native ask qualifies. Remaining cases are not credited.

legacy_frozen_side_time_diagnostic.population: legacy markets, side, and T-59 decision fixed from the old exact-$5 chooser; re-priced on the corrected native ask ladder

portfolio_summaries.drawdown_accounting: cash plus original gross cost basis of unsettled positions; settlement changes equity to cash payout, and no interim mark-to-market is imputed
portfolio_summaries.expected_value: payout probability times net shares less full gross spend and cash collateral fee; no edge threshold beyond EV > 0
portfolio_summaries.settlement_release: max(Gamma closedTime, market start + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds; same convention for all policies
